'''The Lifer''' is an NPC that can be found in [[Oakheart Highcourt]], [[Fagaceae Peninsula]], [[Huanglong]]. It is a [[Chop Chop]] [[Echoes|Echo]] trapped to play a board game eternally.

After defeating it for the first time, The Lifer can be fought again any time. Some of its buffs may be disabled by submitting a [[Stake of Imbalance]] at various Terminals around the maze. These buffs may be re-enabled at any time.

==Tutorials==
{{Tutorial|The Lifer's Game;The Lifer's Buffs}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Enter the designated area)
:'''Abby:''' Wow! It's a massive board game!
:'''Abby:''' But there are only nine circles. Doesn't look like the kind of game you played with Changli.
:'''Rover:''' Yeah, it's more like... some kind of puzzle.
----
;(Talk with the Lifer)
:'''???:''' Leave...
:{{DIcon}}: Are you the "Lifer?"
:{{DIcon}}: What is this place?
:'''The Lifer:''' Leave... here...
:{{DIcon}}: Did someone trap you here?
:{{DIcon}}: How can I get you out of here?
:'''The Lifer:''' Leave... Leave...
:'''The Lifer:''' Leave!
:{{DIcon}}: (Looks like it wants me to go there.)
:'''The Lifer:''' Leave! Here!
----
;(Inspect the device by the Lifer)
:'''Abby:''' What are these scribbles...
:'''Rover:''' Sounds like this big guy is pretty tough to beat.
:'''Abby:''' It says "the shackles that hold the prisoner"... Could they be something to weaken its power?
:'''Abby:''' Maybe you should use your Sensor to check around.
----
;(Lose board game)
:'''The Lifer:''' Ahahaha!
----
;(Win board game)
:'''The Lifer:''' Arraaaagh! Darn it!
:'''The Lifer:''' Stop... leave!
:'''Abby:''' Finally! Time to battle!
:'''Abby:''' Those moving pieces got me so confused... Let's get this over with!
----
;(Defeat The Lifer)
:'''Abby:''' Seems like this Echo has been locked up here since forever...
:'''Abby:''' According to those inscriptions, it doesn't matter who wins or loses the game. It's stuck here guarding this board forever either way.
:'''Rover:''' Maybe it never wanted this at all.
:'''Abby:''' I wonder what kind of life it had before being trapped here...
----
;(Fight the Lifer again)
:'''The Lifer:''' Want... to leave...
:'''The Lifer:''' Leave here... Leave!
{{Dialogue End}}
